title: Sanitary workers’ indefinite strike enters second day in Dindigul

ai.summary: Sanitary workers in Dindigul entered their second day of indefinite strike demanding the Dindigul Corporation fulfill their 10-point charter of demands, including ending the contract system and increasing staff to reduce workload.

facts.claim: The indefinite strike of sanitary workers demanding that Dindigul Corporation fulfil their 10-point charter of demands entered its second day on Thursday.
facts.quote: The indefinite strike of sanitary workers demanding that Dindigul Corporation fulfil their 10-point charter of demands entered its second day on Thursday.

facts.claim: The workers began their indefinite strike and sit-in protest on the Corporation office premises on Wednesday demanding the authorities to fulfil their charter of demands which also included the abolition of the contract system.
facts.quote: The workers began their indefinite strike and sit-in protest on the Corporation office premises on Wednesday demanding the authorities to fulfil their charter of demands which also included the abolition of the contract system.

facts.claim: The workers also demanded that the number of sanitary workers should be increased in the Corporation in order to reduce the workload on the existing workers.
facts.quote: The workers also demanded that the number of sanitary workers should be increased in the Corporation in order to reduce the workload on the existing workers.

facts.claim: The existing number was not sufficient, the workers said, adding that they were overburdened with work.
facts.quote: The existing number was not sufficient, the workers said, adding that they were overburdened with work.

facts.claim: The workers, representing various unions, said the sit-in protest and the indefinite strike would continue on the Corporation premises till their demands were met.
facts.quote: The workers, representing various unions, said the sit-in protest and the indefinite strike would continue on the Corporation premises till their demands were met.

facts.claim: The workers, in their petition, urged the authorities to drop the plans for outsourcing the work.
facts.quote: The workers, in their petition, urged the authorities to drop the plans for outsourcing the work.

facts.claim: They demanded that the authorities end contract system and recruit workers on a permanent basis through direct recruitment.
facts.quote: They demanded that the authorities end contract system and recruit workers on a permanent basis through direct recruitment.

facts.claim: They also urged the authorities to restructure the work shifts. The eight-hour workday should be restructured into a single, continuous shift rather than being split into two separate shifts.
facts.quote: They also urged the authorities to restructure the work shifts. The eight-hour workday should be restructured into a single, continuous shift rather than being split into two separate shifts.

ai.background_note: Sanitary workers in Dindigul have been striking since at least Wednesday for their 10-point charter of demands, including ending the contract system and increasing staff to reduce workload.
